start.title: Сыновья Адама
start.text:
Ты открываешь глаза как первенец Адама и Евы.
Второй сын, Авель, рождается после тебя.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: Твой труд
fields.text:
Проходят годы. Каждый брат находит свой труд.
Каков твой?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: Труд твоего брата
abel_pasture.text:
Ты видишь Авеля через поле.
Что он делает?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: Перед алтарём
offerings.text:
Приходит время принести жертву Господу.
Что ты принесёшь?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: Внимание Господа
accepted.text:
Ты ждёшь, пока Господь смотрит на два приношения.
Что происходит?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: Твоё лицо падает
anger.text:
Приношение закончено. Что-то поднимается в тебе.
Как ты реагируешь?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

warning.title: Грех, притаившийся у двери
warning.text:
Господь говорит с тобой.
Что Он говорит?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: Ты говоришь со своим братом
invitation.text:
Авель подходит близко, доверяя.
Что ты говоришь?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: В поле
field.text:
Вы и Авель одни в открытом поле.
Что вы делаете?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: «Где брат твой?»
confrontation.text:
Голос Господа находит вас.
«Где брат твой Авель?»

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: Беспокойный скиталец
wanderer.text:
Господь ставит на вас знак для вашей защиты.
Вы уходите скитаться на восток от Едема, в землю Нод.
